zh-CN.title: 唐朝建立
zh-CN.shortSummary: 618 年的王朝更替重组了长安及其政治、教育与宗教制度的资源环境。
curatorialDescription: 时间轴以制度环境变化为重点，不把王朝建立简化为单一人物瞬间。
zh-CN.researchNote: 都城控制、制度承接和不同机构转型仍需拆成后续事件。

en.title: Foundation of the Tang dynasty
en.shortSummary: The dynastic transition of 618 reorganized the political, educational and religious resource environment of Chang'an.
curatorialDescription: The timeline emphasizes institutional change rather than reducing the foundation to one biographical instant.
en.researchNote: Control of the capital, institutional continuity and transitions of individual institutions remain to be separated.

zh-CN.title: 玄奘离开长安西行
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 629 年，玄奘的西行把长安与河西、中亚及南亚的求法网络连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 出发是路线证据的起点，不意味着后世地图上的每个节点都已被同等证实。
zh-CN.researchNote: 出发月份、许可叙事与初段路线在不同资料中的差异需继续核对。

en.title: Xuanzang departs Chang'an
en.shortSummary: Around 629, Xuanzang's journey connected Chang'an with pilgrimage networks across the Hexi Corridor, Central Asia and South Asia.
curatorialDescription: Departure begins the route evidence; it does not give every point on later maps equal certainty.
en.researchNote: Month of departure, permission narratives and the first route segment require comparison across sources.

zh-CN.title: 《五经正义》编纂工程
zh-CN.shortSummary: 唐初持续多年的经典整理，把不同注释传统汇入国家教育与考试知识体系。
curatorialDescription: 事件采用时间范围而非单一完成日，以呈现编纂、修订和颁行并非同一步骤。
zh-CN.researchNote: 启动、修订、奏上与使用节点需按正史、目录和版本研究进一步拆分。

en.title: Compilation project of the Corrected Meanings of the Five Classics
en.shortSummary: A multi-year early Tang editorial project brought commentarial traditions into state education and examination knowledge.
curatorialDescription: A range is used because compilation, revision, presentation and institutional use were not one event.
en.researchNote: Commission, revision, submission and use must be separated through histories, catalogues and edition studies.

zh-CN.title: 大慈恩寺建立
zh-CN.shortSummary: 大慈恩寺的建立为长安佛教、译经和皇室支持提供了新的制度空间。
curatorialDescription: 寺院建立与后续译场、塔院和人物活动分开建模，避免把长期制度史压成一个日期。
zh-CN.researchNote: 建立缘起、寺域、早期职事与项目关系需继续核定。

en.title: Establishment of the Great Ci'en Monastery
en.shortSummary: The monastery created a new institutional setting for Buddhism, translation and imperial patronage in Chang'an.
curatorialDescription: Foundation is separated from later translation bureaux, pagoda phases and biographies so a long institutional history is not compressed into one date.
en.researchNote: Foundation account, precinct, early offices and project relationships require further verification.

zh-CN.title: 大雁塔初建
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 652 年的初建阶段把经像保存、译经事业与可见的城市建筑联系起来。
curatorialDescription: “初建”不代表现存形制；后世修建和结构变化必须另行标注。
zh-CN.researchNote: 初建形制、用途与后续改建节点需依据建筑史和保护资料核定。

en.title: First construction of the Great Wild Goose Pagoda
en.shortSummary: The initial phase around 652 linked the preservation of texts and images with translation and visible urban architecture.
curatorialDescription: First construction does not describe the present form; later rebuilding and structural changes require separate records.
en.researchNote: Initial design, uses and later phases need architectural and conservation sources.

zh-CN.title: 义净由海路出发求法
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 671 年，义净由海路南行，提示求法与知识传播并不只有长安以西的陆路模型。
curatorialDescription: 海路事件为路线比较提供入口，同时避免把不同旅行者的行程合并。
zh-CN.researchNote: 出发港、停留点和年代应按义净著述与传记逐项建立路线节点。

en.title: Yijing departs by sea
en.shortSummary: Around 671, Yijing travelled south by sea, showing that pilgrimage and transmission were not limited to an overland route west of Chang'an.
curatorialDescription: The event opens a route comparison without merging different travellers' itineraries.
en.researchNote: Port of departure, stops and dates should be modelled from Yijing's writings and biographies.

zh-CN.title: 武周建立
zh-CN.shortSummary: 690 年的政治转型改变了皇权表达、两京格局与宗教资源配置。
curatorialDescription: 事件不以单一‘崇佛’标签解释复杂政策，而为诏令、造像和机构关系提供时间锚点。
zh-CN.researchNote: 政策、仪式、文本和造像项目应分别引用，不从身份推断统一动机。

en.title: Establishment of the Wu Zhou
en.shortSummary: The political transition of 690 changed imperial representation, the two-capital system and the allocation of religious resources.
curatorialDescription: The event avoids explaining complex policy with a single pro-Buddhist label and instead anchors edicts, images and institutions in time.
en.researchNote: Policies, rituals, texts and image projects require separate citations; motives are not inferred from identity alone.

zh-CN.title: 义净携经回到唐境
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 695 年，义净归来后，海路旅行经验进入翻译、著述与制度网络。
curatorialDescription: 归来节点用于连接路线与文本生产，具体抵达城市和后续行程仍需细分。
zh-CN.researchNote: 抵达地点、入洛时间及译经项目应据传记和经录复核。

en.title: Yijing returns to Tang territory
en.shortSummary: Around 695, Yijing's return brought maritime travel experience into translation, writing and institutional networks.
curatorialDescription: The return links route and textual production; arrival city and subsequent itinerary remain to be separated.
en.researchNote: Arrival place, entry into Luoyang and translation projects require biographical and catalogue verification.

zh-CN.title: 开元时期的制度扩展
zh-CN.shortSummary: 开元时期为观察宫廷、教育、寺观与跨区域交流的资源扩展提供时间范围。
curatorialDescription: 这是研究性阶段标签，不是一次单独事件；下游页面应显示为年代带。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需由具体诏令、机构设置、人物召请和物质项目替换概括性阶段标签。

en.title: Institutional expansion in the Kaiyuan era
en.shortSummary: The Kaiyuan era provides a range for studying expansion in court, education, religious institutions and transregional exchange.
curatorialDescription: This is an analytical period label, not one event, and should appear as a band on the timeline.
en.researchNote: Specific edicts, offices, summons and material projects should replace the general phase label over time.

zh-CN.title: 安史之乱爆发
zh-CN.shortSummary: 755 年开始的战争打断了两京秩序，也改变了人口、财政和宗教机构的资源环境。
curatorialDescription: 事件作为结构性转折呈现，不用宗教兴衰的单线叙事替代区域差异。
zh-CN.researchNote: 长安、洛阳与各地寺观和教育机构受到的影响需分区、分时段核定。

en.title: An Lushan Rebellion begins
en.shortSummary: War beginning in 755 disrupted the two capitals and changed the demographic, fiscal and institutional environment of religious life.
curatorialDescription: The event is a structural turning point; a single rise-and-decline narrative cannot replace regional differences.
en.researchNote: Effects on Chang'an, Luoyang and regional religious and educational institutions require place- and period-specific evidence.

zh-CN.title: 安史之乱结束
zh-CN.shortSummary: 763 年前后的战争结束没有恢复战前结构，而开启了财政、地方权力和机构网络重组的长期阶段。
curatorialDescription: 时间轴区分战争终点与制度后果，避免把“结束”误写为全面复原。
zh-CN.researchNote: 各区域恢复节奏和机构后果需由地方史料与物质资料补充。

en.title: End of the An Lushan Rebellion
en.shortSummary: The end of warfare around 763 did not restore the pre-war order but opened a long restructuring of finance, regional power and institutions.
curatorialDescription: The timeline separates the end of war from its institutional consequences rather than equating an end date with recovery.
en.researchNote: Regional recovery and institutional effects require local histories and material evidence.

zh-CN.title: 会昌宗教政策
zh-CN.shortSummary: 845 年前后的政策集中改变了佛教等宗教机构的财产、人员与公共地位。
curatorialDescription: 条目以政策与执行后果为中心，不将复杂过程简化为一次同质化“灭佛”事件。
zh-CN.researchNote: 诏令序列、地区执行差异、道教与其他宗教的政策位置需分别核定。

en.title: Huichang religious policies
en.shortSummary: Policies around 845 sharply changed the property, personnel and public standing of Buddhist and other religious institutions.
curatorialDescription: The record centres policy and implementation rather than reducing a complex process to one uniform persecution event.
en.researchNote: Edict sequence, regional implementation and the position of Daoism and other religions require separate verification.
